operators.name: custom_view_as_real
semantics: Convert complex64 to real representation by appending last dimension of size 2 containing real and imaginary parts.
Output stride matches reference view_as_real result: last dimension contiguous, preceding dimension stride doubled.

operators.name: custom_einsum_bchw_to_bhwc
semantics: Permute dimensions from [B, C, H, W] to [B, H, W, C].
Equivalent to torch.einsum('bchw->bhwc', x). Output stride pattern [B*H*W*C, W*C, C, 1] (with actual dimension sizes filled).
Supports arbitrary input strides; output is contiguous.

operators.name: custom_clip
semantics: Output is contiguous, same shape as input.
min_val and max_val are scalar Python floats converted to double for kernel launch.
Input x is torch.complex64 CUDA tensor of shape [64, 2048, 2048].
Output is torch.float32 tensor of shape [64, 2048, 2048, 2] with real and imaginary parts interleaved in last dimension.
No data movement except adding dimension; output strides [8388608, 4096, 2, 1] for given input stride.
Equation 'bchw->bhwc' permutes dimensions from [B, C, H, W] to [B, H, W, C].
Output same shape and dtype as input [64, 2048, 2, 2048] float32.
Output contiguous with identical strides as step_002.
